title: OpenVPN: Reassemble TLS control messages of arbitrary size
description:
At one point, OpenVPN always used a fixed 100 byte maximum size for
control messages. This became unwieldy as TLS handshakes kept getting
larger and was changed:

https://github.com/OpenVPN/openvpn/commit/fc91d4b0071178e298052078431fb86f03be84fc

Instead of relying on the fixed 100 byte size, send it to the TLS
dissector and see what it reports. Luckily there's a relatively new
API call for this.

Tested and still works against the old 100 byte max control channel
messages in #8240.

Fix #19914.
